notes.title: Patch 3.1
notes.content:
After additional testing i have discovered that the boss could get too hard at high levels. I have tried out a few changes and settled for higher direct hit damage from the balls and a more effective self destruction. The player will now get a greater reward for killing the boss (+1 skillpoint and +1 life, if not the boss part is the last brick on the level).

I have also added icons displaying what bonus the players recently have picked up and what action the boss is doing. The bonus icon is mainly to help new players to discover what bonus actually killed them or made half the level explode.

[h1]New features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Boss action icon.
[*]Player bonus icon.
[*]Boss reward (Skillpoint and +1 life).
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Boss parts max life 40.
[*]Ball damage to Boss increased from 1+ball hit power upgrade to 7+ball hit power upgrade.
[*]Boss self destruct damage increased from 1 to 2+completed levels.
[*]The player will gain one extra skillpoint from killing the a boss.
[*]Boss kill fadeout (The remaining bricks will fade out and die instead of just disappearing).
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue were SpaceWipe and its defender could get transperant as if you would have been hit by a stun weapon when it actually didnt happened (This bug was rare and i have seen it before but this time i figured out what was wrong).
[/list]

Boss self destruct damage increased from 1 to 2+completed levels.

notes.title: Boss update
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 3.0 Boss update[/h1]
The Boss and Bossrun is finaly here. The boss is scaling with completed levels and created using random algoritms. Kill the Boss to clear the level.

[h2]Boss propteries[/h2]
The boss is created in 1 to 10 chunks of 9 bricks. The Boss parts will support each other.

[h3]Boss brick types[/h3]
[list]
[*]Glowing (3 variations)
[*]Spike (Can destroy the balls.)
[*]Blue eye (Stun weapon.)
[*]Red eye (homing stun weapon.)
[*]Speedy (Balls hitting this brick will gain speed.)
[*]Ghost (Creating robots if hit by a ball.)
[*]Energy (Boosting energy regeneration of close by Boss bricks.)
[*]Healer (Healing one close by Boss brick.)
[*]Activator (Will activate att Boss weapons when hit by a ball.)
[*]Self Destruct (Hit with a ball to active.)
[*]Robot Chest
[*]Robot feet
[*]Protected top (High Armor)
[/list]

notes.title: Stun bricks and friends
notes.content:
A few new bricks have been added including the stun turret and charging bricks. Diamond levels have been updated and i have moved some code behind functions to make the game use less resurces.

[h1]New features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Stun turret brick. (Low life, Stun weapon.)
[*] Charging brick. (Low life. Charging and destroying other bricks.)
[*] Glass brick. (Low life but high armor. Almost invisible at max life.)
[*] Mud brick. (Medium life and high armor against plasma guns.)
[*] Sand stone brick. (High life and high armor against fire.)
[*] Active brick slave. (Low life, immune to AOE.)
[*] Active brick master. (Low life, immune to AOE and activation destroyes all slaves.)
[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*] More of the level code is only processed when the objects are present. (The CPU will only need to run the code when its needed.)
[*] Demo update to current patch.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Changes[/h1]
As requested i have tried to make the game faster between the levels. I have lowered the cooldown on the stats after finishing a level and tweaked the Level Generator a bit. I will likely come back to both those things later.

A new feature in version 1.1 is the bouncing helping arrows. They will help the player to understand where the balls will go when they releae them. It is also possible to change the animation of the arrows if you have managed to complete the "Spinn the Balls 10.000 times" Cow Progress Achievement.

There are also a few more option in the Advanced Graphics Options. You can now change the intensity of the Screen Shake and turn Off or On the automatic FPS safety check.

I wanted both reduce the flashing of the explosive bricks and slow the explosions down a bit to reduce drop of frameate. In 1.1 there is a new animation and a small timer that runs before the brick does explode after it have been hit.

[h1]This is how the Graphics Settings are set at the moment[/h1]
The first time the game is run the game will measure the FPS in the intro. If the game still runs slow (under 30FPS) it lower the setting while playing a level. If the player decides the change the setting in the option menu the game will stop measuring the FPS. The player can also activate "Debug Mode" just before level one. Debug Mode will collect information about the system FPS and create a log file.

tags.balance_change: I have lowered the cooldown on the stats after finishing a level and tweaked the Level Generator a bit.
